headline: An AI-made video of Springbok coach Rassie Erasmus singing to the rugby World Cup trophy is spreading among South African fans after a narrow loss.
score_reason: Pool score kept; light viral clip with no wider consequence.
importance_line: Mostly South African rugby fans are affected; the clip is plainly fake and shows how easily AI video now spoofs public figures.
summary: Briefly News reports that an AI-generated clip, posted by a user called just. fomzy, puts a digital Rassie Erasmus into a famous White Chicks car-singing scene serenading the Webb Ellis Cup, and that South African fans are sharing it widely. It arrived soon after the Springboks' 42-38 loss to Australia in Perth, after which Erasmus faced questions about making 13 squad changes.
notes: Match date not stated in the article.
